name: daltek
description: DALTEK — Système numérique de gestion de files d'attente et de tickets

scripts.android:dev: npm run build && cap sync && cap open android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run build && cap sync && echo 'Run: cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug' && echo 'APK at: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk'
scripts.apk:release: npm run build && cap sync && echo 'Run: cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease' && echo 'APK at: android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk'
scripts.aab:release: npm run build && cap sync && echo 'Run: cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease' && echo 'AAB at: android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab'
